“Any fool can write code that a computer can understand. Good programmers write code that humans can understand.” – Martin Fowler
Unser Erfolg? Teamsache!
Wir sind isento (portugiesisch: „frei“) und realisieren IT-Projekte in Nürnberg von der Konzeption bis zum Rollout. Für eines unserer Teams suchen wir aktuell Unterstützung. Als Software Developer bringst Du Dich dort bei der Entwicklung maßgeschneiderter Lösungen für die Herausforderungen unseres Kundens ein. Wir isentos verstehen uns als Team.

Uns ist es wichtig, dass wir uns jederzeit aufeinander verlassen können - fachlich genauso wie persönlich. Wir unterstützen uns gegenseitig und helfen einander, denn nur so erreichen wir unser gemeinsames Ziel: die beste Lösung für unsere Kunden abzuliefern.
Aufgaben
Dein Job bei isento
Mit deinem crossfunktionalen Team entwickelst du eine Cloudanwendung zur Digitalisierung zentraler Geschäftsprozesse im Bereich Billing & Invoicing.
Dabei tragt ihr die Verantwortung für den gesamten Lebenszyklus der Software von der Konzeption über Entwicklung und Tests bis hin zu Deployment und Monitoring.
Verständlicher Code, Unit- und Integrationstests, Code Reviews, Wissensaustausch und Pair Programming gehören dabei genauso zu Deinem Alltag wie die Konzeption neuer Features und die Abstimmung mit Stakeholdern
In Deinem Projektalltag arbeitest Du mit Technologien wie Angular, Java, Spring Boot, Apache Kafka, PostgreSQL, Object Stores, GitHub Actions und Cloudtechnologien
Dabei bringst Du Dich aktiv ein, entwickelst eigene Ideen und treibst Themen mit Verantwortung und Weitblick voran
Qualifikation
Das bringst Du mit
Du beherrschst Angular und Spring Boot sicher
Softwareentwicklung ist Deine Leidenschaft
Du hast mehrere Jahre Berufserfahrung in Softwareprojekten gesammelt und weißt, worauf es bei skalierbaren, wartbaren Lösungen ankommt
Hilfreich sind Kenntnisse in Spring Boot, GitHub Actions, Apache Kafka, Barrierefreiheit und Cloudtechnologien. Entscheidend ist Deine Bereitschaft, Dich in neue Technologien einzuarbeiten
Du bist neugierig, suchst den Austausch und teilst Dein Wissen, um gemeinsam voneinander zu lernen und zu wachsen
Gute Deutschkenntnisse (mindestens B2) ermöglichen Dir eine souveräne Kommunikation im Team und mit Stakeholdern.

Das bieten wir dir
Zuschüsse: wir unterstützen Dich finanziell beim JobRad-Leasing, beim ÖPNV und bei der betrieblichen Altersvorsorge
Momente für die Ewigkeit: gemeinsam mit Dir feiern wir Grillparties, verbringen Spieleabende zusammen, tauschen uns bei Duke Days aus und stoßen beim Sommerfest gemeinsam an
Wachstum: bring Dich ein und wachse - mit uns als Unternehmen, im Team und ganz persönlich durch individuelle Weiterbildung und Trainings, die zu Dir passen
Freiraum: Flexible Arbeitszeiten und hybrides Arbeiten sorgen für die richtige Mischung aus Work und Life.
Spannung: freu‘ Dich auch auf weitere spannende Projekte bei unseren Kunden und auf unsere hauseigenen Projekte im Bereich Robotik, KI und Machine Learning
Ausgezeichnete Unternehmenskultur: wir sind seit fünf Jahren in Folge ausgezeichnet als Top Arbeitgeber und legen großen Wert auf eine freundliche und von Respekt geprägte Arbeitsatmosphäre
Klingt gut? Dann werde Teil unseres Teams!

About Variant Security
Variant Security is securing the world's critical fleets for the AI era. Today nearly every device runs identical software, so a single exploit can cascade across an entire fleet of satellites, drones, vehicles, and defense systems, and AI has made finding that one exploit cheaper than ever.

Variant breaks that pattern, so compromising one device gives an attacker nothing against the rest and no single failure can bring down the fleet. AI made exploits cheap, and we make them useless, already protecting systems across aerospace, defense, and active conflict zones.

As a Compiler Engineer, you'll build and own the compiler technology at the core of Variant's product, turning cutting-edge diversification into something that ships. You'll work across two areas, the compiler itself and the systems and tooling that run it at fleet scale, with real ownership rather than narrow ticket work.

You'll have a direct line to the founding team, immediate impact on what customers run, and room to grow from a strong early-career engineer into the owner of a core domain. Variant Security is securing the world's critical fleets for the AI era.

Today nearly every device runs identical software, so a single exploit can cascade across an entire fleet of satellites, drones, vehicles, and defense systems, and AI has made finding that one exploit cheaper than ever.

Variant breaks that pattern, so compromising one device gives an attacker nothing against the rest and no single failure can bring down the fleet. AI made exploits cheap, and we make them useless, already protecting systems across aerospace, defense, and active conflict zones.
Tasks
Develop and extend compiler passes that harden builds against exploitation
Reverse engineer and analyze the generated binaries to validate transformations
Measure security and performance impact across x86, AArch64, and RISC-V targets
Build tooling in modern C++ and Python, and integrate the compiler into CMake and customer CI/CD

Master's degree, or equivalent hands-on experience, in cybersecurity or computer science
Hands-on experience with binaries, whether reverse engineering, exploitation, or vulnerability research
Familiarity with Python and modern C++
Comfortable reading assembly and debugging low-level code on at least one of x86, AArch64, or RISC-V
Self-organized and self-driven, with strong personal initiative

Prior work on compilers like Clang/LLVM or IR-level transformations
Familiarity with binary analysis tooling such as Ghidra, IDA, or Binary Ninja
Knowledge of exploit mitigations (ASLR, CFI, stack canaries, DEP)
CTF, pwn, or fuzzing experience (AFL, libFuzzer)
Low-level systems background, spanning embedded, firmware, OS internals, or ELF/PE formats, linkers, and loaders

Work on rare, hard problems where compilers meet binary security, the kind most engineers never get to touch
Early-stage equity and competitive compensation on the ground floor
Learn directly from a founding team with deep security, compiler, and space-systems pedigree (top-tier security research, DARPA, SpaceX)
See your work protect real fleets across aerospace, defense, and active conflict zones
Based in the Bochum office, with regular collaboration across Germany and the U.S. and the chance to work from or visit the US team
We're looking for builders, hackers, and systems thinkers. If this sounds like you, reach out to us.

Company: X Location: Remote-friendly globally. Time-zone band UTC-1 to UTC+5 (meaningful Saudi hours overlap). Optional relocation to Riyadh. Reports to: Custody Platform Lead. Type: Full-time. Individual Contributor. About us: The company is the digital-asset custody and infrastructure platform for the GCC.

We hold institutional crypto safely, settle transactions across chains, and expose all of that as a developer API and a regulated-grade institutional console. The role You are a senior backend engineer with a custody and key-management background.

You will be a foundational engineer on the company's custody platform, reporting to the Custody Platform Lead. You will: Ship production custody code across signing service, key management, chain integrations, and the transaction pipeline. Own a chain or a subsystem.

Within 3 months you should own a meaningful surface end-to-end (a chain integration, a signing-service component, a key-rotation flow). Pair with the Custody Platform Lead and our in-house cryptography function on threshold signing, share generation, and key recovery flows. Write post-mortems when things break.

We treat these as architecture-improvement opportunities, not blame exercises. Integrate new chains. Bitcoin, Ethereum and L2s, Solana, and an active onboarding queue. Engage in async written communication. Spec docs, PR descriptions, async design reviews.

Must-haves 5-plus years of backend engineering , with the last 2-plus years on a custody platform or a key management system at a regulated entity . General fintech does not substitute. Hands-on with at least one of: HSM lifecycle (CloudHSM, YubiHSM, Ledger Vault, similar). MPC / TSS (Fireblocks-style, Sepior, ZenGo, Curv-style).

Threshold signing schemes (GG18, GG20, FROST, CGGMP21, CMP). Production experience with one or more of: Bitcoin (UTXO model, PSBT). Ethereum (EIP-712, EIP-1559, account abstraction). At least one non-EVM Layer 1 (Solana, Sui, Cosmos SDK chain, similar). Reads Solidity, Move, or Rust well enough to integrate with new chains without hand-holding.

Strong async written communication. Your PR threads, design docs, and intro reply are themselves a signal. English fluency. Nice-to-haves Experience with travel-rule / FATF compliance integrations (Notabene, Sumsub, TRP, IVMS101). Authored or contributed to an EIP, BIP, or chain RFC. Audit-contest finalist on Code4rena, Sherlock, or Cantina.

Familiarity with regulated-financial controls: dual-control, four-eyes, M-of-N approvals, SOC 2 evidence collection. This is not the right role if Only frontend / dApp experience, no backend custody or key-management depth. "Crypto trader who codes." Algorithmic trading without custody experience.

Anyone whose entire blockchain experience is a single hackathon, bootcamp, or DeFi side project. Currently subject to a non-compete blocking digital-asset custody for more than 6 months. Stack Backend: Go primary. Some Rust, some TypeScript. Aurora Postgres and ClickHouse. Temporal for orchestration.

Cryptography: in-house MPC stack (TSS-based), HSM integrations, multi-chain signing service. Chains: Bitcoin, Ethereum and L2s, Solana, active onboarding queue. Infra: AWS, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions CI, Terraform. Security posture: SOC 2 Type II in motion, SAMA-aligned, intent toward ISO 27001 and dual-control workflows.

Location, visa, relocation Location: Riyadh, open to Remote Opportunity. Time-zone band: UTC-1 to UTC+5 for meaningful Saudi-hours overlap. Relocation (optional): if the candidate elects to relocate to Riyadh, we’ll support sponsorship. Tax / payroll: KSA payroll for relocators. Contractor or Employer-of-Record for remote-international.

Bei Conceptboard bauen wir ein Kollaborationsprodukt, auf das Enterprise-Kunden, öffentliche Institutionen und sicherheitskritische Organisationen täglich vertrauen. Damit die Teams, die dieses Produkt entwickeln, jederzeit auf voller Geschwindigkeit liefern können, brauchen sie eine Plattform, die ihnen aus dem Weg geht – nicht eine, die sie ausbremst.
Als Platform Architect / Staff Engineer bist du Eigentümer der Core Platform Architecture – und du baust sie selbst, hands-on. Dein Design-Constraint Nummer eins: Die Plattform ist nie der Bottleneck. Du denkst in Self-Service-Capabilities, sauberen Contracts und klaren Boundaries – und du machst das Platform-Team zum Agentic-Engineering-Lighthouse der gesamten Organisation. Das hier ist keine Ivory-Tower-Rolle: Du setzt Richtung, indem du sie shippst.
Your Responsibilities Target Architecture ownen. Du formulierst, validierst und entwickelst die Architecture der Core Platform – inklusive der make-or-break Entscheidungen dahinter. Du bist die primäre Ansprechperson für Architektur-Ownership auf Platform-Ebene und entlastest damit die bestehende Architektur-Verantwortung von einer einzelnen Person.
Hands-on bauen. Du leitest und trägst persönlich zum Proof-of-Concept bei, der die kritischen Hypothesen validiert – und danach zu den Platform Services selbst. Du bist Builder, nicht nur Designer.
Platform as a Product. Du designst Services als Self-Service-Capabilities, die Module-Teams unblocked halten. Thinnest viable Platform beats Gold-Plating, immer.
Contracts & Standards setzen und schützen. Du definierst und sicherst die Contracts zwischen Plattform und Module-Teams: APIs, Boundaries, Non-Functional Requirements – und sorgst dafür, dass sie eingehalten werden.
Agentic-First von Tag eins. Du etablierst disziplinierte Agentic-Engineering-Practices im Platform-Team und machst es zur Referenz für die gesamte Engineering-Organisation.
Lead by Example. Du inspirierst dein Team mit einem Platform-First-Mindset. Deine Teammitglieder wachsen, weil sie dir zuschauen – und weil du die Standards, die du setzt, selbst lebst.
Alignment mit dem Architect. Du arbeitest eng mit dem bestehenden Architect zusammen, um übergreifende Architektur-Entscheidungen abzustimmen und zu validieren.
Dein Profil Must-haves
Hands-on Builder mit starkem Track Record. Du hast Plattformen oder Services at scale architektiert und gebaut – und du codest noch. Kein reiner Architecture-by-PowerPoint-Hintergrund.
Platform-as-a-Product-Instinct. Du hast Self-Service-Plattformen gebaut, die andere Teams schneller gemacht haben. Du weißt, wie Plattformen zum Bottleneck werden – und designst aktiv dagegen. Interne Teams sind für dich echte Kunden.
Sound Engineering Practices. Testing, Contracts, Observability, CI/CD, klare Boundaries – und das Urteilsvermögen, welche Non-Functional Requirements tatsächlich zählen.
Genuine Motivation für Agentic Engineering. Du willst Agentic-First mit Disziplin bauen, nicht mit Hype – und du willst es für andere modellieren.

Erfahrung in regulierten Umgebungen mit hohen Compliance-Anforderungen.
Relevante Domain-Tiefe für eine Collaboration-Plattform, z. B. Distributed Systems oder Real-Time-Architektur.
Erfahrung mit Agentic-First-Workflows – privat oder professionell.
Das erwartet dich bei uns Flexibilität – Genieße umfassende Freiheit bezüglich deines Arbeitsortes und gestalte deine Arbeitszeiten ganz nach deinen Bedürfnissen.
Eigenverantwortung – Bei uns hast du die Möglichkeit, selbstständig und eigenverantwortlich zu arbeiten, unterstützt von einer flachen Hierarchie und kurzen Entscheidungswegen.
Internationalität – wir arbeiten in einem globalen Team, das kulturelle Vielfalt schätzt und fördert. Unser internationales Netzwerk ermöglicht es dir, weltweit Kontakte zu knüpfen.
Zusammenhalt – Wir wissen, wie wichtig persönliche Treffen sind, um den Teamgeist zu stärken. Daher organisieren wir regelmäßig Social Events.
Wettbewerbsfähige Vergütung – Du erhältst ein attraktives Gehaltspaket und 30 Tage Urlaub pro Jahr.
Mitarbeitervorteile – Nutze eine Vielzahl von Vergünstigungen über unseren externen Corporate Benefits Partner.

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to help us take REDAPL, our Referential Data Platform, to the next level. REDAPL is Datadog's main platform for tracking our customers' infrastructure resources and relationships. The platform enables products where customers can understand, keep track of, and gain insights into their infrastructure related to performance, cost, security, and more.
Many Datadog products use REDAPL today such Cloud Security Posture Management, Resource Catalog, Cloud Cost Management, and Service Catalog and others - REDAPL ingests more than 4.5mil updates/second.
As a Senior Engineer, you will drive, lead and collaborate on projects both inside and outside the platform. You can expect to contribute to key technical decisions relating to our data ingestion, processing, and query pipelines.
At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

Build a query engine that supports efficient relationship traversals for our most demanding workloads.
Contribute to design and drive high-priority, high-visibility projects to increase the platform's value, resilience, and scalability across multiple teams.
Lead and guide other engineers through architectural platform decisions
Identify potential system risks and trends in reliability and design solutions to address them
Provide input on prioritizing engineering-led initiatives in short- and long-term planning and roadmaps
Collaborate with internal product teams to understand their requirements and how we plan for their product growth as they integrate and depend on REDAPL

You have a BS/MS/PhD in a Computer Science, Engineering or related scientific field or equivalent experience
You have worked extensively with multiple types of data stores.
You have contributed to initiatives in a platform or infrastructure-focused environment for several years
You have led impactful technical initiatives in an environment where performance, cost efficiency, ease of use, and resilience/operability are first-order concerns
You have significant back-end engineering experience and have built, and operated distributed systems to solve problems at a high scale

You have experience working with Graph Databases such as Neo4j, Memgraph, JanusGraph, ArangoDB, Amazon Neptune or PuppyGraph.
You have production-grade experience with Apache Iceberg
You have a solid grasp of query planning or better yet - contributed to a production-grade query engines or related projects (e.g. Trino, Calcite, Substrait, DataFusion, etc) ideally demonstrated through open-source contributions or PMC membership on projects.

Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold.

Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center.

As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

Anduril’s Maritime Division has assembled a diverse team of experts in software, robotics, artificial intelligence, sensor fusion, and data analysis to create software and hardware solutions that radically evolve the capabilities of our customers.

We are fielding the next generation of autonomous systems to tackle the extremely challenging industry demands of maritime operations.

Anduril has brought to market a unique, ultra-long-range, full-ocean-depth underwater vessel platform and a completely refreshed maritime vehicle and flexible manufacturing architecture that scales from "small" to "extra-large" vehicle sizes.

Today, Anduril is executing on billion-dollar contracts while simultaneously performing Robot-as-a-Service (RaaS) AUV operations.
We are seeking to sustain our early successes with deep investment in an expanded product portfolio. These products, including Dive-XL, Dive-LD, Copperhead, Seabed Sentry, and other unannounced systems, will deliver a coherent system-of-systems, enabling the end-to-end conduct of a variety of autonomous missions in the maritime domain.

If you are passionate about solving problems that have real impact and working on systems that directly contribute to achieving national strategic priorities, we want you to join Anduril’s Maritime Division and help us build the future of defence capability.

Senior Software Engineering Managers independently lead groups of teams to deliver a variety of software integrated in to our products. This includes autonomy, simulation, data processing, payload integration, and off-board command and control or decision support.

We expect Senior Software Engineering Managers to demonstrate independent end-to-end outcome ownership of software for an integrated product family, and the teams responsible for building and maintaining it.

Senior Software Engineering Managers contribute as a group lead to the rapid architecting, design, delivery, support, and evolution of next generation autonomous platforms through their entire product life-cycle.

Manage architecture selection and design for robotic systems, including hardware selection, compute, storage and network architecture, service orchestration and other software platform concerns that balance constraints, restrictions and requirements in a multi-stakeholder environment

Influence peers and executives within your broader cross-functional engineering organization, ensuring that software engineers who are employed in cross-functional engineering teams reporting to your peers are appropriately employed and managed
Act as a subject matter expert for software engineering, representing software equities in a multi-stakeholder environment including engineering, business and sales leadership
Drive the design and implementation of development processes for the initial delivery and subsequent iteration of software, including full lifecycle testing
Build and manage a 12 - 36 month roadmap for your group, nested within broader organisational and company roadmap
Manage an allocated budget for your group
Manage programmatic risk for your group, and collaborate with your Technical Lead to manage technical risk, including sound and timely decision making
Lead by example as a technically competent, trustworthy, and accountable leader
Contribute to the development of organizational vision and strategy, then communicate it effectively to your group
Define, document, gain consensus for, and communicate appropriate goals and plans for your group, derived from broader organizational vision, strategy, and priorities
Build your subordinate teams and managers through mentoring, professional development, career management, and collaboration with Anduril’s recruiting and people functions
Work as a leader of a multi-disciplinary engineering group of 10 - 24 members, including as a mentor and manager for engineers and managers from differing backgrounds, and with “dotted line” responsibility for an additional 10 - 24 software engineers that report to your peers
Report to a manager who typically will not have a background in software engineering
Travel to co-locate with end-users and/or other teams up to 20% of the time

Job description We are building modern, customer-facing software for the temp-staffing industry, integrating capabilities from multiple ERP systems and countries into reliable applications, workflows, services, and reusable platform components.
We are looking for a product-minded senior fullstack engineer who can turn ambiguous business requirements and complex existing systems into production-grade backend services, APIs, integrations, internal tools, and intuitive user interfaces.
TypeScript is central to our technology landscape. Experience with .NET and C# is strongly valued, while engineers with a background in strongly typed languages such as Java are also welcome. Comfort working across different stacks and languages is essential.
AI and LLM tooling are central to how we work. You should use AI-native workflows to explore faster, build in parallel, validate assumptions, and ship high-quality production solutions. You should care about correctness and maintainability, understand integration and business edge cases, choose simple and robust solutions, and own outcomes from exploration to production.
Your tasks Fullstack Product Engineering: Build customer-facing applications, backend services, APIs, internal tools, admin interfaces, automation, job runners, and configurable workflows
Backend & Domain Logic: Design maintainable services, APIs, business logic, asynchronous processes, validation rules, and reusable components
Frontend Engineering: Build intuitive and maintainable user interfaces using TypeScript and modern frontend frameworks
Integrations: Connect applications with ERP systems, internal platforms, external APIs, databases, queues, files, and third-party services
Cloud & Production Ownership: Deploy and operate reliable cloud solutions, preferably AWS, owning monitoring, alerts, failure handling, security, performance, cost, and operational reliability
Your profile Hands-on with Claude Code, Codex, and agent-based workflows; GitHub Copilot-style autocomplete alone is not enough
Familiar with worktrees, subagents, MCP, structured prompts, harness engineering, parallelization, and validating AI-generated code and analysis to production quality
Strong fullstack/backend experience, ideally with .NET and TypeScript
Able to build production-grade services, APIs, scripts, tools, automation, and clean interfaces; comfortable with version control, review, debugging, testing, and existing systems
Strong understanding of application architecture, API design, domain modeling, integration patterns, asynchronous processing, and maintainable software boundaries
Comfortable with SQL, relational databases, schema design, transactions, migrations, indexing, and application-level data access
Hands-on with AWS or similar cloud environments, including storage, databases, queues, containers, serverless/scheduled processing, SDKs, and APIs
Understands deployment, secrets, networking, permissions, runtime configuration, scalability, performance, cost, and operational trade-offs
You may be a good fit if you are driven to improve how software is built, use AI and agent-based workflows to move faster, experiment with better approaches, and turn ambiguous problems into reliable production solutions.

You should enjoy working across the stack, taking ownership beyond predefined tickets, improving existing systems, and rigorously validating AI-generated output rather than accepting it at face value.

This role is less suitable for someone who prefers narrow responsibilities, fixed processes, or working within a single technical area without contributing to broader product and engineering outcomes.
Your benefits Work across AI-powered SaaS and cloud-native products, use modern AI tooling daily, and shape pragmatic infrastructure that helps teams ship faster and more safely
Collaboration in an empathetic, appreciative team with room to contribute ideas and take ownership
Individual development opportunities, structured onboarding, and interdisciplinary collaboration
Flexible working models including hybrid work, home office, and mobile working
A modern tech environment and agile ways of working
Additional benefits such as pension plans, health offers, and employee discounts

* Gérer des applications conteneurisées sous Linux et des environnements multi-conteneurs à l'aide de Podman et des outils Compose
* Mettre en place une infrastructure CI/CD auto-hébergée et établir des processus automatisés de compilation, de test et de déploiement

* Exploiter et faire évoluer des bases de données PostgreSQL, des composants d'intégration et des solutions de stockage (NAS, S3)
* Concevoir des tests systématiques (tests de bout en bout, tests d'intégration et tests unitaires) et rédiger la documentation (manuels d'utilisation, descriptions de services)
****Ce qui vous rend unique****
* Diplôme d'une haute école (spécialisée) en informatique ou formation équivalente et expérience dans l'exploitation ainsi que le développement de systèmes informatiques complexes
* Très bonne maîtrise de Python, notamment dans le développement et la maintenance d'applications avec Flask et Gunicorn
* Bonnes connaissances de Linux, Podman ou Docker, ainsi que des processus de CI/CD et des workflows basés sur GitHub
* Expérience dans le domaine des solutions de suivi et de journalisation, ainsi qu'avec PostgreSQL; idéalement, des connaissances d'Apache Camel, de NAS ou de S3
* Connaissances actives d'une langue officielle et bonnes connaissances de l'anglais
****En quelques mots****
Jouez un rôle central dans le développement et le bon fonctionnement du système de traitement automatisé des données des élections et des votations.

Au sein d'une petite équipe très motivée, vous participerez notamment à la conception de l'infrastructure CI/CD et contribuerez ainsi de manière décisive à la réussite d'un important projet de numérisation dans le domaine des droits politiques en Suisse. Ce poste est limité à fin 2027, car il est lié à un projet.

Si vos compétences le justifient, il est envisageable de garder, au terme du projet, un poste au sein de la division pour des missions transversales intéressantes.
****Ce que nous offrons****
* **Travailler pour la Suisse** Nous nous engageons pour le succès du modèle suisse et pour le bien-être de la population.
* **La diversité au quotidien** Nous veillons à l'égalité des chances, qui nous permet de déployer nos compétences et d'exprimer des points de vue différents.
* **Santé au travail** Nous assistons et conseillons nos collaboratrices et collaborateurs pour toutes les questions liées à la santé physique ou psychique.
[Tous les avantages](https://www.stelle.admin.ch/stelle/fr/home/bundesverwaltung/ihre-vorteile-auf-einen-blick.html)
****La statistique compte. Pour vous aussi.****
L'Office fédéral de la statistique (OFS) est le centre de compétences de la statistique publique et l'acteur principal de l'écosystème suisse des données.

Il produit des informations statistiques, œuvre pour l'harmonisation des données par le biais d'une gestion nationale des données et élabore des processus tirés de la science des données pour faire évoluer l'interprétation des données.

L'OFS contribue ainsi à la formation de l'opinion publique et apporte une contribution importante à la gouvernance démocratique moderne.
****Informations complémentaires****
La division Santé et Affaires sociales est à la pointe du traitement efficace et automatisé des données statistiques et administratives destinées à diverses parties prenantes. Les jours d'élections et de votations, l'équipe du domaine Politique assure la publication des résultats des élections et des votations quasiment en temps réel sur différents canaux.

Your impact at gridX As a Junior Software Engineer on the Platforms Team, you’ll play a key role in bridging the gap between external cloud ecosystems and the gridX platform. As part of the Cloud Connector team, your work is the bridge between the gridX platform and the outside world.

You will build and maintain the backend services that allow us to seamlessly integrate with external energy providers. Your code will turn complex, varied external APIs into standardized, reliable connections that the rest of our engineering organization relies on.

By developing robust APIs and smart integration tools, you empower gridX to onboard new cloud assets faster, making energy management seamless for our customers and platform partners alike.
Are you ready to # makeamark, #getshitdone , and build the future of energy? Apply now and join our mission!
Please note: We only accept applications from candidates who are currently located in Germany.
How you can contribute to gridX What you’ll work on
Integrations with partners: Your primary focus is seamlessly integrating various cloud providers into our ecosystem. This involves implementing and maintaining Go services that abstract away provider-specific edge cases, allowing us to reliably gather measurements and send control commands. You'll work closely with API specs, frequently leveraging AI coding tools to accelerate your implementation and review cycles.
Fast scaling: You’ll engineer solutions for a fast-scaling platform handling around 20.000 cloud-connected assets. With our managed fleet growing over 80% the past 6 months, you’ll play a critical role in designing architecture that handles heavy telemetry and real-time control at scale.
Cross-team Collaboration: The Cloud Connector is the critical bridge connecting physical devices to gridX’s wider platform architecture. You'll build the cloud integrations that link assets to our platform, ingest asset data for various services, and route real-time execution commands back to the assets via cloud providers.
We use AI-assisted and agentic coding workflows extensively, from code generation and review to spec analysis and test creation. You'll be expected to leverage these tools effectively and help actively shape our evolving engineering culture.
Day-to-day, that means
Implementing new cloud integrations based on API documentation, OAuth specifications, and webhook contracts.
Evolving the integration framework, refactoring event-processing chains, migrating data stores, and shaping the abstractions that make future integrations simpler.
Debugging distributed pipeline failures using structured logs, distributed traces, and metrics, across OAuth flows, webhook processing, and event delivery.
Writing tests that cover provider API contracts, webhook edge cases, command delivery reliability, and distributed failure modes.
Contributing to API specifications (TypeSpec/OpenAPI, protobuf/gRPC) that connects to downstream gridX services and external partners.
Collaborating with cloud API teams , Product Owners, Platform Engineers, and Energy Domain Experts.

Pragmatism over perfection: You ship working software, iterate, and don't gold-plate.

Fullstack Developer \- AI \& Digital Health \- FR
Description de l'entreprise
Swiss Medical Network est l'un des groupes de cliniques privées les plus importants de Suisse. Il s'est fixé pour objectif d'offrir des soins médicaux de premier ordre à ses patients suisses et étrangers.

Swiss Medical Network convainc par la haute qualité de ses prestations, un environnement de travail agréable et une équipe de direction expérimentée à l'esprit entrepreneurial. Le réseau exploite actuellement 21 cliniques et hôpitaux dans toute la Suisse et est présent dans les trois principales régions linguistiques.
Description du poste
En tant que Fullstack Developer (AI \& Digital Health), vous jouez un rôle moteur dans la transformation numérique de nos cliniques. Vous concevez et développez des solutions logicielles innovantes assistées par l'IA, qui améliorent le parcours du patient tout en soulageant le personnel médical. Vous agissez comme un pont technique entre les exigences médicales et les technologies de pointe, garantissant que nos applications de santé numériques sont sécurisées, évolutives et conviviales.

Votre domaine d'activité
Développement \& Architecture de solutions : Conception et implémentation d'applications web Fullstack évolutives (Frontend \& Backend) pour un usage clinique et administratif.
Intégration de l'IA : Développement et intégration de modèles d'apprentissage automatique (Machine Learning), de LLM (Large Language Models) et de services d'IA déterministes (explainable AI) dans des applications existantes et nouvelles pour soutenir les processus diagnostiques ou administratifs.
Données \& Interfaces : Connexion des applications aux systèmes primaires cliniques (KIS/HIS/DPI) en utilisant des standards d'interopérabilité modernes (ex. FHIR, HL7\) et garantie d'un échange de données fluide.
Security by Design : Garantie des standards de sécurité les plus élevés et de la conformité à la protection des données (LPD/RGPD) lors du traitement des données sensibles des patients, en étroite coordination avec le délégué à la protection des données.
DevOps \& Cloud : Mise en place et maintenance de pipelines CI/CD ainsi que gestion de l'infrastructure Cloud pour l'exploitation des solutions d'IA.
Prototyping : Développement rapide de preuves de concept (PoC) pour évaluer le potentiel des nouvelles technologies d'IA pour le quotidien clinique et les rendre tangibles.
Collaboration : Étroite coopération avec les Data Scientists, les médecins et le personnel soignant afin de créer des solutions centrées sur l'utilisateur ("User Centricity").
Votre profil
Formation : Diplôme universitaire en informatique, ingénierie logicielle ou qualification comparable avec un fort accent sur les technologies web modernes.
Compétences en développement : Expérience approfondie dans les frameworks Backend (ex. Python, , Java) et Frontend (ex. React, Angular, modernes, idéalement sur la Google Cloud Platform (BigQuery, Looker). Des connaissances en Python sont privilégiées en raison de l'orientation IA.
Expertise en IA : Expérience pratique dans l'intégration de composants IA/ML (ex. API OpenAI, LangChain, Hugging Face, TensorFlow) dans des environnements logiciels productifs.
Secteur de la santé : Une expérience avec les normes du secteur de la santé (FHIR, HL7, DICOM) est un avantage, mais pas obligatoire si vous êtes prêt à vous y former. Une expérience avec le "Software as Medical Device" et les processus de certification correspondants constitue un atout majeur.
Méthode de travail : Un mode de travail autonome, agile (Scrum/Kanban) et orienté solutions. Vous avez une mentalité "Can\-Do" et prenez plaisir à résoudre des problèmes complexes par le code.
Personnalité : Esprit d'innovation couplé à une conscience de la qualité. Vous savez rendre des sujets techniques compréhensibles pour des interlocuteurs non techniques.
Langues : De langue maternelle allemande avec un niveau courant/négociation en français (ou inversement) ; de bonnes connaissances en anglais sont requises pour la collaboration au sein de nos équipes linguistiques régionales.
Tech\-Stack : Des connaissances en technologies de conteneurisation (Docker, Kubernetes), plateformes Cloud (Azure/GCP) et gestion de versions (Git) sont prérequis.
Informations supplémentaires
Notre offre
Innovation : Nous vous offrons la possibilité de travailler à la pointe de l'innovation médicale et de développer des solutions d'IA qui apportent une véritable plus\-value à la vie des patients.
Création : Vous bénéficiez d'une grande marge de manœuvre technique dans un environnement dynamique qui favorise les circuits de décision courts et la pensée entrepreneuriale.
Environnement : Un climat de travail inspirant au sein d'une équipe interdisciplinaire composée de médecins et de spécialistes IT, un package salarial attractif ainsi que des prestations sociales progressistes vous attendent.
Développement : Réjouissez\-vous de projets passionnants avec les dernières technologies et une grande responsabilité personnelle au sein d'un groupe de cliniques en pleine croissance.

Aufgaben
React & TypeScript – Grundsolide
Du musst keine Senior-Expertise mitbringen, aber du musst React wirklich verstanden haben: Komponenten, Props, State, Hooks (useState, useEffect, useContext), einfache Custom Hooks. TypeScript sollte dir nicht fremd sein – du musst keine komplexen Generics schreiben, aber du musst Typen definieren und Fehler im Compiler lesen können.
Supabase – Bereitschaft zur schnellen Einarbeitung
Du solltest wissen, was eine relationale Datenbank ist, SQL-Grundabfragen schreiben können (SELECT, INSERT, JOIN) und das Konzept von Authentifizierung und Autorisierung verstehen. Supabase selbst kannst du on the job lernen – aber der Wille, dich in Row Level Security, Supabase Auth und Echtzeit-Subscriptions einzuarbeiten, muss vorhanden sein. Wenn du schon mal mit Supabase, Firebase oder PocketBase gearbeitet hast: großer Vorteil.
Grundlegendes Verständnis von Web-Entwicklung
HTTP, REST APIs, JSON, Formulare, Routing – das muss sitzen. Du weißt, was ein API-Aufruf ist und wie man mit fetch oder axios Daten holt.

Wer sie als Turbo für die eigene Produktivität begreift: herzlich willkommen.
Git & grundlegender Deployment-Workflow
Commits, Branches, Pull Requests – das muss funktionieren. Du solltest wissen, wie man eine App auf Vercel deployt oder zumindest bereit sein, das in Stunde 1 zu lernen.
Eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten
Wir haben keine Zeit für Mikromanagement. Du bekommst ein Gewerk, ein Ziel und wöchentliche Check-ins. Dazwischen arbeitest du selbstständig, dokumentierst sauber und fragst, wenn du wirklich feststeckst – aber nicht nach jedem kleinen Problem.
Usability, UI & UX – Empathisches Produktgefühl
Du entwickelst nicht nur Features, die technisch funktionieren, sondern Oberflächen, die Menschen gerne benutzen. Du hast ein gutes Gespür dafür, wann ein Formular zu kompliziert ist, ein Button nicht eindeutig genug wirkt oder ein Flow unnötig Reibung erzeugt.

Pixel-Perfektion ist nicht das Ziel – aber Empathie für Nutzer:innen, saubere Interfaces, klare Zustände, verständliche Fehlermeldungen und ein Blick für einfache, intuitive Bedienung sind uns extrem wichtig. Du denkst beim Entwickeln mit: „Versteht das jemand sofort?“ – und nicht nur: „Läuft der Code?“

Meet DeepL
DeepL is a global AI product and research company focused on building secure, intelligent solutions to complex business problems. Over 200,000 business customers and millions of individuals across 228 global markets today trust DeepL's Language AI platform for human-like translation, improved writing and real-time voice translation.
Founded in 2017 by CEO Jaroslaw “Jarek” Kutylowski, DeepL now has around 1,000 passionate employees and is supported by world-renowned investors including Benchmark, IVP, and Index Ventures.
Our goal is to become the global leader in trusted, intelligent AI technology, building products that drive better communication, foster connections, and create a meaningful impact. To achieve this, we need talented people like you to join our journey. If you’re ready to shape the future of AI and grow your career in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment, DeepL is your next destination.
What sets us apart
What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected.
When we share what it’s like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. This might be because of our technology that helps millions of people and businesses communicate and work better every day, or because of the trust, curiosity, and care that shape our culture.
What we know for sure is this: being part of DeepL means joining a team dedicated to innovation, growth, and well-being. Discover more about life at DeepL on LinkedIn , Instagram , and our Blog .

s.h: Meet the team behind this journey
s.t:
DeepL is not just a translation tool; we are building the Operating System for Global Communication . We are the rare AI company that builds the entire stack in-house: from training next-gen LLMs on our own NVIDIA DGX SuperPODs to delivering real-time Language AI to over 300 million users and 200,000+ businesses globally.
You will join DeepL Voice , the team defining the art of the possible for real-time interpretation. While our Translation engine conquered text, Voice is conquering the physical world. We are building the "Universal Translator"; enabling fluid, real-time conversations for frontline workers, global meetings, and enterprise teams.
This is a 0-to-1 engineering environment. We successfully launched our first customer-facing features in late 2024, but we are just getting started. We are tackling the hardest problems in AI interaction: How do you eliminate the "flickering" effect of unstable transcripts? How do you chain chunked inference to achieve sub-millisecond latency? How do you deliver a seamless audio stream that feels natural, not robotic?.
You will work in a dynamic, cross-functional squad alongside Researchers, Product Managers, and Designers. We are not just wrapping an API; we are building the proprietary models, the streaming architecture, and the user interfaces that allow the world to speak without barriers.

A "0-to-1" Builder Mindset: You thrive in ambiguity. You don't need a roadmap to build; you need a problem. You are comfortable prototyping a new feature in the morning and refactoring it for scale in the afternoon.
Product Obsession: You care about the flow of the conversation. You understand that "99% accuracy" means nothing if the audio arrives 3 seconds late. You optimize for the human experience.
Ship End-to-End Features: Build and deploy impactful features across the entire stack, from high-performance frontend UIs to streaming audio services on the backend and AI inference integration.
Tackle Real-Time Complexity: Debug and resolve challenging edge cases unique to real-time communication, including sub-second latency spikes, transcript flicker, audio glitches, and unstable network environments.
Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Partner closely in a tight-knit, cross-functional squad alongside PMs, Product Designers, and AI Researchers to scope, shape, and solve hard product and technical challenges.
Qualities we look for
A "Product-First" Mindset: You care deeply about the customer journey. You ask, "How does this feature help us close the next Enterprise deal?" before writing code.
Full-Stack Fluency: You're comfortable across the stack — building polished, modern UI in React and TypeScript on the frontend, and shipping backend services in Node.js/TypeScript (or a strongly transferable language, with willingness to ramp) on the backend.
Real-time: WebRTC, WebSockets, streaming architectures, latency-sensitive systems.
High Agency: You don't wait for permission. If the billing reconciliation process is slow, you automate it. If the documentation for the API is unclear, you fix it.
AI-Native Velocity: You leverage AI-powered tools (like GitHub Copilot or Claude) to accelerate your velocity and eliminate repetitive toil. You use AI for boilerplate code, test generation, and debugging, allowing you to focus your cognitive energy on high-value architectural decisions and complex problem-solving.
A Note on Our Hiring Process: DeepL hires for the Company , not just a specific team. We operate a Unified Engineering Pipeline . If you pass our bar, we will match you to the highest-priority role that fits your skillset—whether that is in Core Product, Platform, Voice, or Enterprise. We prioritize "Missionaries" who want to solve the biggest problems, wherever they live in the stack .

Diverse and internationally distributed team : joining our team means becoming part of a large, global community with people of more than 90 nationalities. We're more than just colleagues; we're a group of professionals with a shared mission to connect diverse cultures. Our global presence is growing–we've doubled in size nearly every year, with our employees based in the UK, Germany, the Netherlands, Poland, the US, and Japan, and we continue to expand our network.
Open communication, regular feedback : as a language-focused company, we value the importance of clear, honest communication. We value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and growth mindset makes us better together.
Hybrid work, flexible hours : we offer a hybrid work schedule, with team members coming into the office twice a week. This allows you to engage directly with your team and experience the unique energy of our workspace, while still enjoying the flexibility and comfort of working from home. With flexible working hours and trust in your productivity, we are in sync with your team’s general locations and time zones to foster effective and seamless collaboration.
Virtual Shares - An ownership mindset in every role. We believe everyone should share in our success, and that’s why every employee receives Virtual Shares, linking your contribution directly to DeepL’s growth and rewarding you with a stake in our future.
Regular in-person team events : we bond over vibrant events that are as unique as our team, from local team and business unit gatherings, to new-joiner onboardings, to company-wide events that bring us all together–literally.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT.

Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles.

Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
Canonical is looking for exceptional security-focused software engineers to be integrated across product teams. While they also contribute to the product as engineers, their primary focus is to challenge the entire team to think more deeply about security through state-of-the-art practices such as threat modeling, table-top exercises, architecture and design reviews, static analysis tools, and fuzzing, among others.
These roles encompass all aspects of product security, including feature development, vulnerability response, proactive security, and open source community participation. Engineers in these roles collaborate closely with other Canonical teams, customers, and partners across the open source ecosystem.
Each product engineering team at Canonical reserves one or two openings for security-oriented software engineers. We also develop a number of products driven entirely by security needs, such as our AppArmor kernel investments and the Ubuntu Security Guide (USG).

As the publisher of Ubuntu, we also handle long-term security response for the entire operating system and open source ecosystem. Working with tens of thousands of upstreams means that we need to be fluent in every major programming language and design, build, and adopt sophisticated tools that enable us to work at scale and speed with confidence.
Apply here if you are an exceptional security-focused software engineer, passionate about open source, and excited by Canonical's products and mission.
This role requires the ability to be productive in a globally distributed team through strong self-discipline and motivation. It also involves mandatory international travel at least twice a year, typically for one week.
Location: Worldwide, this is a globally remote role

s.h: Este rol NO es para ti si
s.t:
Prefieres que te lleguen las tareas ya definidas. Se te va a decir qué hay que lograr, no cómo. Escalas lo que no esté a tu alcance; el resto lo resuelves.
No estás dispuesto a salir de tu lenguaje. No pedimos que llegues sabiendo las tres tecnologías: sí que ninguna te frene.
Buscas un entorno protocolar y ordenado. Somos un scale up con cultura de startup: se avanza rápido, se acepta deuda y hay que ser capaz de crear orden dentro de la fluidez.

+5 años desarrollando software y experiencia real como fullstack.
.NET/C# sólido. Es el backend del producto y ahí esperamos fuerza real. Python, que usan los servicios que consumes, se aprende acá.
React de cara al cliente. No necesitas ser el referente de front, pero sí construir features completas y sostener las convenciones del squad.
Clean Architecture aplicada, no leída. Inversión de control, dominio aislado de la infraestructura, el tecnologías específicas como piezas desechables: arquitectura evolutiva de verdad.
Testing como parte del entregable. Cobertura unitaria más tests de integración que levantan las piezas del caso de uso, con terceros simulados. Acá no hay QA: cada equipo prueba hasta donde el riesgo quede manejado.
Diagnóstico de performance e incidentes. Leer señales de la aplicación —observabilidad, trazas, métricas— y concluir qué dicen del software. La base de datos es un caso concreto: leer el plan de ejecución en vez de adivinarlo, índices, escaneos de tabla.
Tomar cualquier tarea técnica del producto, de punta a punta. React en el front de cara al cliente, .NET en el backend y Python en los servicios que ese backend consume. No entras a cubrir un hueco de tecnología: entras para que el squad pueda avanzar en los tres frentes a la vez, sin mayor acompañamiento.
Mandar a producción rápido para aprender del uso real. Valoramos llegar a tiempo al mercado, así que muchas decisiones se toman sabiendo que dejan deuda. Cada sprint reserva un espacio que planifica el propio equipo para robustecer lo que ya se validó como core: distinguir qué deuda se paga y cuál se deja viva es parte del rol.
Desarrollar con agentes y con contención. Vamos hacia un enfoque agéntico antes que de supervisión humana, y eso se sostiene con tests y restricciones alrededor de lo que hace el agente, no con fe.
Compartir el objetivo de negocio. El norte es el mismo para todo el squad: quienes vienen del lado de producto y quienes vienen del lado técnico persiguen el mismo resultado. Entiendes la tesis de negocio detrás de un requerimiento antes de implementarlo, y descartas rápido lo que no funciona.
Construir para el Maxxa que viene. Ya operamos en México y estamos evaluando el próximo país. El segmento al que apunta este producto —la empresa chica, la que nadie financia— es el mismo en toda la región, y lo que validemos acá es lo que se lleva.
Sostener el estándar sin autoridad formal. El producto se apoya en servicios que construyen otros equipos de Tecnología. No los diriges: los alineas, con criterio propio sobre qué aceptas recibir.
Cómo se ve que vas bien. Tomas tareas de complejidad creciente sin acompañamiento, los flujos que tocas quedan con su cobertura de tests y empiezas a proponer qué se robustece. Eso es lo que miramos, y se conversa contigo desde el primer día.
Haber construido en un producto en validación de mercado , no solo en líneas maduras y estables.
Haber aprendido un stack o tecnología nueva sobre la marcha y haber llegado a ser productivo rápido en ella.
Uso fluido de herramientas de IA para desarrollo (Claude Code, Cursor) con arnés propio: instrucciones de repo, skills, tests como límite del agente.
Formación en Ingeniería Civil en Computación / Informática, Industrial mención TI/Computación o afines. No es excluyente.
En Tecnología nos organizamos en squads de tres a cinco ingenieros con su product owner. La expectativa mutua es ser cada vez mejores ingenieros: hay referentes cercanos en casi todos los frentes, con harta disposición a compartir.
